drhp.business: The Company is engaged in Plantation activity, with tea as the crop dealt with; the main business is tea cultivation, tea manufacturing, and the sale and export of tea. It operates the Katary and Sutton Estates in the Nilgiris District of Tamil Nadu, spanning 631.769 hectares, with a factory that has facilities to produce Orthodox Tea. Currently the company produces 100% Orthodox Tea, and tea production during the year included bought leaf alongside its own estate crop.

risks.note: Management calls this the major threat for the plantation industry - the yearly increase in cost of production is not at all proportionate with the increase in sale realization, which structurally compresses plantation margins.
risks.risk: Cost of production rising faster than sale realisation

risks.note: Plantation crops are generally prone to vagaries of nature and erratic monsoon, so crop volume and quality are outside management control.
Market potential exists for tea but is constrained by stiff competition from global, national and local players, limiting pricing power.
Any recession in the general economy may affect the plantation industry also; the outlook depends on consistent demand for plantation crops throughout the year.

The Company is engaged only in plantation activity, the crop dealt with is Tea, and it currently produces 100% Orthodox Tea from two estates in the Nilgiris District - so earnings depend on one crop, one product form and one growing region.

The outlook is stated to depend on a higher realization commensurate with the cost of production and on the growth of the packet tea segment; the sale price for Orthodox Tea increased over the previous year, making earnings sensitive to that price cycle.
risks.risk: Realisation dependence on Orthodox tea prices and the packet tea segment

risks.note: Credit risk on exports is identified by management and is mitigated by insuring the credit through Export Credit and Guarantee Corporation Limited (ECGC).
Managed through adequate insurance coverage of fixed and current assets and a conservative debt policy under which the debt component is very marginal.
risks.risk: Asset and financial risk on fixed and current assets
